title: Ashgrove CareAssure Policy Specifications: Free Look, Contestability and Suicide Exclusion Periods
content:
Policy specifications — Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance. Each Ashgrove CareAssure policy carries three fixed contract periods: the free-look period, counted in calendar days from delivery; the contestable period, counted in years from the issue date or the reinstatement date; and the suicide exclusion period, counted in years from the issue date.

| Tier | Free-look period | Contestable period | Suicide exclusion period |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ashgrove CareAssure 2-Year | 30 calendar days from delivery | 2 years from issue or reinstatement | 2 years from issue |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 3-Year | 30 calendar days from delivery | 2 years from issue or reinstatement | 2 years from issue |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 4-Year | 30 calendar days from delivery | 2 years from issue or reinstatement | 2 years from issue |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 5-Year | 30 calendar days from delivery | 2 years from issue or reinstatement | 2 years from issue |
| Ashgrove CareAssure 6-Year | 30 calendar days from delivery | 2 years from issue or reinstatement | 2 years from issue |
| Ashgrove CareAssure Lifetime | 30 calendar days from delivery | 2 years from issue or reinstatement | 2 years from issue |

Specification notes:

1. The three periods are the same in all six tiers.
2. The contestable period runs from the issue date, or from the reinstatement date where the policy has been reinstated; the suicide exclusion period runs from the issue date only, and a reinstatement does not restart it.
3. Example with hypothetical dates: on a policy issued on 1 March 2025 and reinstated on 1 September 2026, the suicide exclusion period runs to 1 March 2027 while the contestable period, counted from the reinstatement, runs to 1 September 2028.
